items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Expands SpaceX Stake to $69 Billion and Deepens AI Ties
items.summary: Alphabet (NasdaqGS: GOOGL) has expanded its SpaceX stake by nearly 4 million additional shares, lifting the holding’s value to about US$69b. The position has grown from an original US$900m investment, reflecting a very large increase in the implied equity value. Alphabet has agreed to pay SpaceX monthly for Nvidia GPU access that will support the Gemini Enterprise AI platform. items.title: AST SpaceMobile Is Building Its Own Reusable Rocket to Rely Less on SpaceX
items.summary: AST SpaceMobile wants its own rocket, and Firefly is cashing in before a single engine fires. The deal could cost shareholders more than dilution, and the satellites that actually earn revenue still sit on the ground.

items.title: AI Stocks Diverge as Democratic Election Victory Sparks Rotation Into Cloud Giants
items.summary: US technology stocks experienced a significant shift in investor positioning on Wednesday, as the Democratic Party’s election victory raised concerns about potential restrictions on new data centre developments. Investors moved toward established cloud computing companies while reducing exposure to semiconductor manufacturers and AI infrastructure developers.

items.title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Just Issued a 6-Word Warning That Could Spell Disaster for AI Stocks
